rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of siddhisaṃprāptiḥ and mūlakaulaṃ; equates attainment of powers with the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The eight accomplishments are enumerated in this context.
The attainment of these accomplishments is identified with the root Kaula.
This identification is declared directly to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight accomplishments is itself the essence of the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact scope of the eight accomplishments is supplied by the preceding context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
